² Squared

6 × 6 = 36

³ Cubed

4 × 4 × 4 = 64

√ Square root

√49 = ?

7 (7 × 7 = 49)

∛ Cube root

∛125 = ?

5 (5 × 5 × 5 = 125)

A power tells you how many times to multiply.

🏠 Menu

🤫 Keep it secret

You tell 3 mates a secret. Each of them tells 3 more...

How many new people hear it in round 4?

🤔 Guess first! Write it down.

Step 1

Rounds 1, 2, 3

3, 9, 27

Step 2

Round 4

27 × 3 = 81 = 3⁴

81 people: 3⁴. Some secret! 🤫
